synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-/+4, A3 apart / A4 together; each block moves alone if target cell is in [2,58], not a marker cell (marker xy-1), not the other block, not a maze cell.
Step 124 mechanic: block_left (18,18)->(22,18) is blocked by an invisible maze cell (22,18) while block_right moves on; blocks are not confined to their half. The global bar counter does not decide marker A4 outcomes (that is maze blocking + armed mode).
A6 on an inactive marker arms it (blocks -> color_1 players, A1-A4 move the active marker), A6 on a player disarms, other clicks/A5 no-ops.
Bar w = floor(3(a+1)/7), a = actions since level start, tracked with continuity gate; fallback = largest a with that width (0 if no bar). Names = type_color_rank by (y,x), from 2 in block mode.
Unconfirmed: maze cell (22,18) has no visible cause; unseen maze cells unknown; stateless replay only 14/31 because bar width alone is ambiguous.
